PhD in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
Prepare for advanced roles in industry or for a rewarding career in academia and research.
Conduct cutting-edge research alongside faculty in areas such as:
Aerospace Navigation, Vehicles
Fluid Power Systems
Metamaterials, Elasticity
Nanomaterials, Nanotechnology, Topological Insulators
Thermal Management, Materials
Machine Learning
The PhD ME requires a minimum of 72 credit hours beyond the bachelor’s degree, including credit hours taken during the MS program. Students who received the MS degree from a university other than MU may transfer a maximum of 30 hours from their MS degree hours.
